title: i10 Racer TC-2

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the HJC i10 Racer TC-2 is crafted for daily urban navigators conquering dense traffic. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1301g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~85 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Snell protection at an entry-level price point.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; features a wide visor opening for improved peripheral vision.

technical_analysis: Features Premium Integrated Matrix (P.I.M. Plus) carbon and carbon-glass hybrid fabric shell structure paired with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism. The interior utilizes ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the HJC i10 Racer TC-2: combining South Korea 🇰🇷 craftsmanship with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism and ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: HJC i10 Racer TC-2: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide

introduction: Positioned in HJC's Full Face lineup, the i10 Racer TC-2 brings South Korean engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The HJC i10 Racer TC-2 represents HJC's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the HJC i10 Racer TC-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
